Website article

Repair or replace your garage door? A simple guide Repair it if: one spring or cable has failed, rollers are noisy, or the door is off track after a bump. These are usually same-day fixes. Think about replacing it if: panels are dented or rusted through, the door is uninsulated and your garage bakes in the Texas summer, or you're paying for repairs every year. Either way, a good technician shows you both options and lets you choose. That's how we've earned 353 five-star reviews. Call My Choice Garage at (469) 954-3861 for an honest look.
